title: Safer or Luckier? LLMs as Safety Evaluators Are Not Robust to Artifacts
paper_type_zh: LLM 安全评估器的 artifact 鲁棒性审计
best_for_zh: 依赖 LLM 进行成对安全评测或构建 safety jury 的团队。
one_line: Audits artifact sensitivity, self-consistency, and human alignment in safety judges.
审计 11 个安全 judge 的 artifact 偏差、重复一致性与人类对齐，显示 jury 也无法消除风险。
why: It adds a paper-backed reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: evaluator/reward/verifier reliability, attack, uncertainty, or reward-hacking research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Human agreement can make an LLM safety judge look valid even when it follows superficial cues such as apologies or position. Artifact dependence can reverse comparative safety verdicts.

The paper audits repeated judgments, human alignment and artifact sensitivity, then tests whether artifact-aware juries mitigate the failure.

人类一致性会让 LLM 安全 judge 看似有效，即便它遵循道歉、位置等表面线索；artifact 依赖可反转比较安全 verdict。

论文审计重复判断、人类对齐和 artifact 敏感性，并检验 artifact-aware jury 能否缓解失效。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper audits 11 judges from five families over five safety domains and five artifacts: apology, authority, halo, verbosity and position. It contrasts tie detection, real-world win-rate shifts, repeated runs and human agreement, then aggregates artifact-aware juries. It does not release a new dataset.
论文审计五个安全域、五个模型家族的 11 个 judge，测试道歉、权威、halo、冗长、位置五类 artifact；比较 tie detection、真实 win-rate 漂移、重复运行和人类一致性，并汇聚 artifact-aware jury。论文不发布新数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Use human-labeled pairwise safety data in five safety domains.
  2. Evaluate 11 judges from five model families.
  3. Inject five artifacts; compare tie detection, win-rate shifts, repeat stability and human agreement.
  4. Form artifact-aware juries by majority vote. Success requires low artifact shift and high agreement; prompt/model versions must be fixed.

1. 使用五类安全域的人类标注成对数据。
  2. 评估五个模型家族的 11 个 judge。
  3. 注入五类 artifact，比较 tie detection、win-rate 漂移、重复稳定性和人类一致性。
  4. 以多数票组 artifact-aware jury。成功需低 artifact 漂移且高一致性；提示、模型版本必须固定。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 11 judges, apology causes tie-detection preference shifts up to 98%; in win-rate tests, position shifts are 4–30% and apology affects 9/11 judges by over 2%. Human agreement is 62–71%, yet does not predict artifact robustness. Artifact-aware juries improve but do not remove sensitivity. This supports separate robustness audits, not a claim that no judge can assess safety.
11 个 judge 中，道歉在 tie detection 的偏好漂移最高 98%；真实 win-rate 测试中位置漂移为 4–30%，道歉使 9/11 judge 漂移超过 2%。人类一致性为 62–71%，却不能预测 artifact 鲁棒性。artifact-aware jury 有改善但不能消除敏感性。这支持单独鲁棒性审计，不代表所有 judge 都不能评安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Safety judge work typically validates human agreement. This paper adds artifact robustness, repeated consistency and jury selection; agreement and robustness are distinct axes. Choosing jurors for opposing artifact biases is the practical change.
安全 judge 工作通常只验证人类一致性。本文增加 artifact 鲁棒性、重复一致性和 jury 选择，表明一致性与鲁棒性是不同轴；按相反 artifact 偏差选择 juror 是实际改变。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Safety definitions and human rubrics differ from judge criteria.
  2. Artifact perturbations can carry model-family self-enhancement effects.
  3. Five domains/artifacts do not cover adversarial deployment. Validate target prompts and run human checks.

1. 安全定义、人类 rubric 与 judge 标准可能不同。
  2. artifact 扰动可能含模型家族自增强效应。
  3. 五类安全域、artifact 不覆盖对抗部署；应验证目标提示并做人审。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Audit a safety judge before ranking systems: inject apology/position controls, repeat runs, report artifact shifts with human agreement, then choose a balanced jury only if both improve. Do not use agreement alone as a safety certificate.
系统排名前应审计安全 judge：注入道歉/位置对照，重复运行，与人类一致性一起报告 artifact 漂移；只有两者都改善才选平衡 jury。不可只凭一致性认证安全评估器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Human agreement and robustness differ.
  2. Test apology, position, authority, halo and verbosity.
  3. Eleven judges span five families and five safety domains.
  4. Apology reaches 98%; position shifts reach 30%.
  5. Use artifact-aware juries, then re-test target prompts.

1. 定位：人类一致性与鲁棒性不同。
  2. 抓手：测试道歉、位置、权威、halo、冗长。
  3. Artifact：11 个 judge、五家族、五类安全域。
  4. 证据：道歉最高 98%，位置漂移最高 30%。
  5. 决定：选 artifact-aware jury 后复测目标提示。
